channel.title: CoinDesk
channel.description: Trimmed fixture: titles, links, dates and excerpts of at most 280 characters.

item.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
item.description: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

item.title: Crypto thieves are using online ads to infect iPhones with a single tap, research finds
item.description: A malicious ad campaign known as MoldyRoost can compromise vulnerable iPhones with a single tap, putting cryptocurrency wallet seed phrases at risk, according to cybersecurity firm Confiant.

item.title: Bitcoin sold for $17,000 on Kraken's Canadian dollar market, and the trades stand
item.description: An apparent breakdown in Kraken's CAD order book cut every coin on it by over 70%, overnight.

item.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
item.description: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.
